sourceGaps: 2005T4: This attributed 2009 Volume 2 collection prints Part A and Part B as one connected problem. In 4.B-2 it prints $\mathrm{AlCl_4^-}$ and trimethyl-n-octylammonium bromide, while the preparative paragraph names tetra-n-octylammonium bromide. These are retained. The key keeps $E^\circ=+1.00\ \mathrm{V}$ next to the reversed oxidation reaction; its equilibrium numerator is typeset “AuCI4” without a visible charge. Its second formation-constant line prints $10^{2542}$, unlike the preceding $10^{25.42}$. The 4.B-4 symbolic radius ratio has an additional outer cube, and the final symbolic denominator in the shell method contains the primed radius, unlike the unprimed numerical denominator. No silent scientific correction is made.

2005T5: All alternative Lewis drawings, including the alternatives marked incorrect, are part of the printed key and retained. The question uses “triangular planar” while the key uses “trigonal planar”. The drawings are bounded native artwork; the questions, atom charges, oxidation states and geometry answers remain editable.

2005T6: All printed fallback branches are retained. In key 6.6(a), the first bicarbonate factor lacks the square shown in its subsequent substitution and other branches. Both 6.8 branches print $4[\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}]$ without a cube. The first 6.8 dissolved-carbon-dioxide value has no printed exponent. These source discrepancies and the key's “Ca2*” fallback are preserved, not silently repaired.
2005T7: The printed 7.2 equilibrium-approximation depletion equation has no factor 2, whereas 7.3 has that factor under the steady-state approximation. Both literal printed forms are retained.

2005T8: The question requests SI units in 8.2, while the key prints $0\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$; this literal unit is retained. The red spelling underline beneath the native graph's $f_U$ label is present in the collection image and retained. The referenced answer sheet is not included in this obtained task span.
